brief: A drawer unit that is quiet to open and looks pretty on a bookshelf.

requirements.evidence: Slide-style drawer (n:slide) pulls on slides rather than scraping; but noise also depends on print material and fit, which the configurator does not check.
Compact half-hex base with top cover and end cap, sized for a shelf; staged with a small terracotta pot (prop:1) on top.

finish.summary: Half-hex drawer unit with a slide-style drawer for smoother/quieter opening, capped and covered, staged with a small plant pot for a pretty shelf look. Quietness is shape-helped only; actual noise depends on material and print quality.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

results.saw: met: Looks pretty on a bookshelf
